note: Voice never changes the term by itself: speaker identity cannot be established from a recording, so the endpoint returns a reviewable transcript draft. A signed-in coordinator edits and submits it through the typed term-change flow, where Muse Spark parses it and CP-SAT verifies every reassignment. Spelled-out academic titles from speech recognition are normalized deterministically before any later parse (app/parsing/parser.py).
